description: Initial release: 10 patches for Telegram Web (org.telegram.messenger.web) 10.2.0 (40569) — Unlock Premium, Bypass integrity check, Disable auto-update, Remove ads, Download speed boost, Hide typing indicator, Anti-delete messages, Anti-screenshot notification, Disable channel switching, Voice to music.

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents messages deleted by other users from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-screenshot notification
patches.description: Blocks screenshot notifications from being sent to the other user.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches.name: Disable auto-update
patches.description: Disables automatic app update checks, the blocking update screen, and the proxy sponsor channel insertion.

patches.name: Disable channel switching
patches.description: Disables the pull-down gesture that switches to the next unread channel.

patches.name: Download speed boost
patches.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages from all chats and channels.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features for the current account.

patches.name: Voice to music
patches.description: Plays voice notes in the full music player with seek bar and background playback.

release_notes: Initial release: 10 Morphe patches for Telegram Web (org.telegram.messenger.web) 10.2.0 (versionCode 40569).
